verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows Jira letting users build or configure their own custom AI agent. Rovo AI is documented only for creating custom automations (reminders and rules), which is an adjacent feature rather than agent building. Assigning work to external coding agents and the MCP server/CLI connect outside agents to Jira; they are not an in-product agent builder.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build and configure my own custom AI agent within the product
